words.definition: A live music show.
words.example: We got tickets to the concert on Friday.

words.definition: A place where you watch plays or movies.
words.example: Let's meet outside the theater at seven.

words.definition: A person who plays a role in movies, TV or plays.
words.example: Who's your favorite actor?

words.definition: A funny movie, show or play.
words.example: I'm in the mood for a comedy tonight.

words.definition: A set of TV shows that tell a story over many parts.
words.example: I'm binge-watching a new series.

words.definition: One part of a TV or radio series.
words.example: Did you watch the last episode?

words.definition: The people who watch or listen to a show.
words.example: The audience clapped for five minutes.

words.definition: A group of musicians who play together.
words.example: My brother plays guitar in a band.

words.definition: The raised area where actors or musicians perform.
words.example: The singer walked onto the stage.

words.definition: An opinion about a movie, book or product.
words.example: The restaurant got a great review.

words.definition: To make a loud sound, like a phone or a bell.
words.example: Your phone is ringing!

words.definition: To press the numbers on a phone to call someone.
words.example: Dial nine to get an outside line.

words.definition: A spoken message left on a phone for you to hear later.
words.example: I got your voicemail. I'll call you back.

words.definition: The connection that lets a phone or radio work.
words.example: I have no signal in the basement.

words.definition: The link between your device and a network or another person.
words.example: The connection is bad. Can you hear me?

words.definition: To answer in words or writing.
words.example: She never replies to my messages.

words.definition: To get in touch with someone by phone or message.
words.example: You can contact me any time after six.

words.definition: A figure used to count, or the digits of a phone number.
words.example: Can I have your number?

words.definition: To send a short written message from a phone.
words.example: Text me when you're outside.

words.definition: To turn the sound off.
words.example: You're on mute. We can't hear you.

words.definition: A plan for how you will spend your money.
words.example: We're on a tight budget this month.

words.definition: To keep money so you can use it later.
words.example: I'm trying to save for a new laptop.

words.definition: To use money to pay for things.
words.example: I spend too much on coffee.

words.definition: To get money by working.
words.example: She earns more than her husband.

words.definition: To have to pay money back to someone.
words.example: I owe you ten dollars for lunch.

words.definition: Money you pay regularly to use a house or room.
words.example: Our rent goes up in January.

words.definition: Money that you borrow and must pay back.
words.example: They took out a loan to buy a car.

words.definition: Money you pay to the government.
words.example: There's a tax on every item we sell.

words.definition: A way of paying later for things you buy now.
words.example: Can I pay by credit card?

words.definition: To have a certain price.
words.example: How much does this ticket cost?

words.definition: In a short time; at high speed.
words.example: She quickly finished her homework.

words.definition: With attention, to avoid mistakes or danger.
words.example: Read the instructions carefully.

words.definition: Almost not at all.
words.example: I can hardly hear you.

words.definition: Nearly, but not completely.
words.example: We're almost there.

words.definition: Completely correct or precise.
words.example: That's exactly what I meant.

words.definition: More than others; in particular.
words.example: I love fruit, especially mangoes.

words.definition: In fact; really.
words.example: I actually prefer tea.

words.definition: Not long ago.
words.example: Have you seen any good movies recently?

words.definition: Without any doubt.
words.example: I'll definitely be there.

words.definition: In the correct way.
words.example: The door doesn't close properly.

words.definition: Full of light, or strong in color.
words.example: It's too bright in here. Can you close the curtains?

words.definition: With little or no light.
words.example: It gets dark early in winter.

words.definition: Making a lot of noise.
words.example: The music was too loud to talk.

words.definition: Wide from one side to the other.
words.example: She cut a thick slice of bread.

words.definition: Not wide from one side to the other.
words.example: The walls are so thin that I can hear my neighbors.

words.definition: Extremely small.
words.example: They live in a tiny apartment.

words.definition: Extremely big.
words.example: There was a huge crowd outside the stadium.

words.definition: Having a surface with no bumps.
words.example: The table feels smooth.

words.definition: Not smooth or even.
words.example: The sea was rough, and many people felt sick.

words.definition: Bright because it reflects light.
words.example: She wore shiny red shoes.

days.theme: Inside the Body: brain, bone, heart

words.definition: The organ in your head that controls your thoughts and body.
words.example: Your brain needs sleep to work well.

words.definition: One of the hard parts inside your body.
words.example: He broke a bone in his foot.

words.definition: The organ that pumps blood around your body.
words.example: My heart was beating fast.

words.definition: The upper front part of your body.
words.example: He felt a pain in his chest.

words.definition: The part of your body between your head and shoulders.
words.example: I slept badly, and now my neck hurts.

words.definition: The part of your body where your arm joins your body.
words.example: She carried the bag on her shoulder.

words.definition: The joint in the middle of your leg.
words.example: I hurt my knee playing basketball.

words.definition: The back of your mouth and the tube that goes down your neck.
words.example: I have a sore throat.

words.definition: The soft part in your mouth that you use to taste and speak.
words.example: I burned my tongue on the soup.

words.definition: One of the hard white parts in your mouth that you use to bite.
words.example: I lost a tooth yesterday!

words.definition: A person you do not name.
words.example: Someone left their umbrella here.

words.definition: Any person. It does not matter who.
words.example: Does anyone want more coffee?

words.definition: A thing you do not name.
words.example: I need to tell you something.

words.definition: Not any thing.
words.example: There's nothing to eat in the fridge.

words.definition: All things.
words.example: Everything is ready for the party.

words.definition: In or to a place you do not name.
words.example: Let's go somewhere quiet to talk.

words.definition: In or to any place.
words.example: I can't find my keys anywhere.

words.definition: Anything or everything. It does not matter what.
words.example: Choose whatever you like. It's my treat.

words.definition: Any person who. It does not matter who.
words.example: Whoever finds my wallet will get a reward.

words.definition: At any time, or every time that.
words.example: Call me whenever you need help.

words.definition: A warm knitted top.
words.example: Take a sweater. It's chilly.

words.definition: A long piece of cloth you wear around your neck.
words.example: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.

words.definition: Coverings for your hands, with a part for each finger.
words.example: I forgot my gloves, and my hands are freezing.

words.definition: Strong shoes that cover your ankle.
words.example: Wear boots. The ground is wet.

words.definition: Trousers made of strong blue cotton.
words.example: I wear jeans almost every day.

words.definition: Short pants that end above the knee.
words.example: It's so hot that I'm wearing shorts.

words.definition: Special clothes that everyone in a group wears.
words.example: The students wear a blue uniform.

words.definition: Loose clothes you wear in bed.
words.example: The kids are already in their pajamas.

words.definition: Light shoes with straps, worn in warm weather.
words.example: I wore sandals to the beach.

words.definition: A coat that keeps you dry in the rain.
words.example: Take a raincoat. It might pour.

words.definition: In addition.
words.example: I also speak Spanish.

words.definition: Also, or more than needed.
words.example: Me too! The soup is too hot.

words.definition: To a high degree.
words.example: The food is very good.

words.definition: In addition, or different.
words.example: What else do you need?

words.definition: Not any.
words.example: None of my friends came.

words.definition: Any one of a group.
words.example: Take whichever one you like.

words.definition: Almost not.
words.example: I could scarcely breathe.

words.definition: At all. Used for emphasis after a negative.
words.example: I have no idea whatsoever.

words.definition: Not now, not any longer.
words.example: I don't live there anymore.

words.definition: In general.
words.example: Overall, it was a good trip.

words.definition: An informal word for father.
words.example: My dad cooks on Sundays.

words.definition: An informal word for mother.
words.example: Mom, can I go out?

words.definition: An informal word for grandmother.
words.example: Grandma bakes the best cookies.

words.definition: An informal word for grandfather.
words.example: Grandpa tells great stories.

words.definition: The son of your son or daughter.
words.example: They have a grandson who is four.

words.definition: The daughter of your son or daughter.
words.example: She sent a card to her granddaughter.

words.definition: The woman your father marries after your mother.
words.example: His stepmother is very kind.

words.definition: The man your mother marries after your father.
words.example: My stepfather taught me to fish.

words.definition: A child whose parents have died.
words.example: The orphan was adopted.

words.definition: A man who promises to help a child grow up in a faith.
words.example: He's my godfather.
